scripts.test:firebase: npm --prefix functions run sync-shared && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-the-mood --only auth,firestore,functions "vitest run -c vitest.firebase.config.js"
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run sync-shared && firebase emulators:start --project demo-the-mood
scripts.seed:emulator: FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8080 GCLOUD_PROJECT=demo-the-mood npm --prefix functions run seed
scripts.e2e:firebase: npm --prefix functions run sync-shared && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-the-mood --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "playwright test -c playwright.firebase.config.js"
